subject: Arrival corridor access plan for leadership workshop
messages:
From: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@acmeinc.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Visitor credentials & arrival window for Apr 20 exec workshop

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for hosting the leadership workshop on Apr 20. Security at Acme needs a consolidated list and some access constraints so our legal and facilities teams can approve travel and badges. Can you confirm the following?

- Primary arrival window for exec team (we have 8 people)
- Point of contact for onsite escort (name & mobile)
- Whether temporary badges will allow access to the second-floor conference corridor or escorts are required at all times
- Any device policies (laptops / recording devices) or badge-locked doors we should warn the VPs about

I'm attaching the attendee manifest we've collected (acme_lead_visitors_20270405.csv). We'll need Redwood to provide badge IDs and a request to your front desk/security to pre-provision.

Also note: Acme requires an executed NDA on file for one of the vendor-presentations; I can push those via DocuSign today if you confirm the contact.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Samir and I are coordinating travel.

Cheers,
Olivia Martin
Director, Strategic Accounts
Acme Inc
olivia.martin@acmeinc.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@acmeinc.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmeinc.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visitor credentials & arrival window for Apr 20 exec workshop

Thanks Olivia — looping in Ben and Vivek to confirm logistics and badge flow. Quick plan proposal below:

- Arrival window: 08:30-09:15 (we'll schedule the workshop start for 09:30; last security checkpoint opens at 08:15)
- Escorting: Front-desk badges will grant lobby access only. Second-floor corridor requires escorted access; Redwood will provide 2 escorts in 90-minute shifts (Ben and Marissa to cover first half, Vivek to cover VIP transfer at midday).
- Badge provisioning: We'll pre-provision temporary badges tied to the names in your CSV. Please confirm DOB (MM/DD/YYYY) and government ID last 4 if any of the attendees are non-US citizens — that can affect vendor badging turnaround time.
- Device policy: Small laptops are allowed; recording devices must be declared and checked with security. We'll add a short clause to the visitor briefing.

Attachments: I've dropped an escort-roster template (site-escort-roster-template.xlsx) and will upload a front-desk pre-provision request to security once we have the final DOB/ID fields.

Action items:
- Olivia/Samir: confirm DOBs or flag any non-US passport holders by EOD Tue (Apr 6)
- Ben: confirm escort shift names and provide mobile numbers by Wed (Apr 7)
- Vivek: approve the corridor escort policy and confirm fallback if badge provisioning is delayed

I'll prepare the DocuSign routing for the NDA once Olivia confirms the signer. If anyone wants to do a dry run at the front desk next week, we can schedule a 15-minute slot.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Manager, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 650-555-0123

--
Attached: site-escort-roster-template.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visitor credentials & arrival window for Apr 20 exec workshop

Sounds good — I can take the 08:30-10:00 escort shift and Marissa will cover 10:00-11:30. Vivek, I'll text you the mobile numbers once I have the final roster.

Note for front desk: we'll stage 10 temp badges at 08:10; badge printing will happen on-site (we tested the printer last week). If security needs a signed access request, I'll submit the form by Wed morning.

Ben

From: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@acmeinc.com>

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 19:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Visitor credentials & arrival window for Apr 20 exec workshop

Perfect, thanks Rachel — we've updated the CSV with DOBs and passport last-4 where applicable (see acme_lead_visitors_20270405.csv). Two quick notes:

- One attendee (Victor Rao) is a UK passport holder — he will email his passport scan to security separately; please confirm if that requires any additional lead time.
- We've attached the signed NDAs (acme_vendor_ndas_signed.pdf) and a short vendor access waiver that Acme legal requires for the vendor demo.

Travel: arrival ETA is 08:45 for five execs, and two additional guests will join directly at 09:20 — both groups should be covered by the escort schedule you proposed.

If you can send a one-line confirmation to our security team (security@acmeinc.com) with the front-desk badge request reference number, that will close our approvals.

Thanks all — Samir and I will be on standby for any changes.

Best,
Olivia
